meaning:
Νινευείτης (Rec. -ενίτης, L, -ΐτης), -ου, ὁ
a Ninevite: Mat.12:41, Luk.11:30, 32.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone…
For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.
